nodes.description: Biallelic germline DHTKD1 variants reduce or abolish functional E1a. The index patients were compound heterozygous for a start-loss variant (c.1A>G) or a nonsense variant (c.1228C>T, p.Arg410*) together with the recurrent missense variant c.2185G>A (p.Gly729Arg). Later series added missense, nonsense, splice-donor, duplication and deletion-insertion alleles. Most tested missense variants impair folding or stability and reduce activity, although three tested variants showed no defect.

nodes.description: E1a acts only when assembled on the 24-mer DLST (E2o) core with DLD (E3). The recurrent p.Gly729Arg variant and other missense variants impair this assembly, either by disrupting the E1a-DLST interface or by destabilising E1a, which impairs channelling of intermediates between E1a and E2o.

nodes.description: E1o (OGDH) can also decarboxylate 2-oxoadipate, and DHTKD1 assembles with OGDH, DLST and DLD into a hybrid 2-oxoglutarate/2-oxoadipate dehydrogenase complex. In GCDH-deficient cells lacking DHTKD1, OGDH accounts for the remaining glutarylcarnitine production. This route is proposed to limit the metabolic consequences of DHTKD1 loss; how much flux it carries in patients is unknown.
